exposure: 25 ug 2-hourly oral Misoprostol for induction of labour
50 ug 4-hourly oral Misoprostol for induction of labour
outcome: composite neonatal outcome (Apgar <7 at 5 mins and/or NICU admission)
cohort: Women with a vital singleton pregnancy between 37+0 and 42+0-weeks of pregnancy with an indication for induction of labour with oral Misoprostol.
finding: The induction of labour protocol using 25 ug oral Misoprostol was associated with a significant decrease in the composite neonatal outcome compared to the 50 ug protocol.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in caesarean section rate between the two Misoprostol protocols.
